n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: I want to tell a story too! It's about a dragon. But it's a real one. Probably.

translations.fa: من هم می‌خوام قصه بگم! دربارهٔ یه اژدهاست. ولی واقعیه. احتمالاً.

branches.suggestion: Ooh, a real dragon? Tell us everything!
branches.suggestionFa: اوه، یه اژدهای واقعی؟ همه چی را بگو!

branches.suggestion: Where did you meet this dragon?

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: In the garden! Behind the shed. He was green and sad because nobody would play with him.

translations.fa: تو باغ! پشت انباری. سبز بود و ناراحت چون هیچ‌کس باهاش بازی نمی‌کرد.

branches.suggestion: Oh no, poor dragon. What did you do?
branches.suggestionFa: ای وای، اژدهای بیچاره. چی کار کردی؟

branches.suggestion: Why wouldn't anybody play with him?

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Because he breathed fire by accident when he sneezed! So I gave him a tissue.

translations.fa: چون وقتی عطسه می‌کرد تصادفی آتیش بیرون می‌داد! پس بهش یه دستمال دادم.

branches.suggestion: That was very kind. Did the tissue catch fire?
branches.suggestionFa: خیلی مهربونی کردی. دستمال آتیش گرفت؟

branches.suggestion: Clever idea! Did it stop him sneezing?
branches.suggestionFa: فکر هوشمندانه‌ای! عطسه‌اش را بند آورد؟

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Yes, it burned up! So I gave him Grandad's handkerchief instead. That's why Grandad can't find it.

translations.fa: آره، سوخت! پس به جاش دستمال پارچه‌ای پدربزرگ را بهش دادم. واسه همینه که پدربزرگ پیداش نمی‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: So that's the mystery of the missing handkerchief solved!
branches.suggestionFa: پس معمای دستمال گم‌شده حل شد!

branches.suggestion: Ha! I think Grandad will want it back.
branches.suggestionFa: ها! فکر کنم پدربزرگ پسش بخواد.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: The end! Did you like it? Was it the best story ever? You have to say yes.

translations.fa: پایان! خوشت اومد؟ بهترین قصهٔ دنیا بود؟ باید بگی آره.

branches.suggestion: It was the best story I've ever heard. Brilliant twist at the end!
branches.suggestionFa: بهترین قصه‌ای بود که تا حالا شنیدم. پیچش عالی آخرش!

branches.suggestion: Absolutely. You're a natural storyteller, Nicola.
branches.suggestionFa: قطعاً. تو یه قصه‌گوی ذاتی هستی نیکولا.

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Yay! Next time I'll tell the one about the dinosaur who became Prime Minister!

translations.fa: آخ جون! دفعهٔ بعد قصهٔ دایناسوری را می‌گم که نخست‌وزیر شد!
